definitions.gloss: various places; each place; different regions
definitions.explanation: Multiple places across a country, region, or area. Often used in news reports and formal contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧{各地|かくち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}き→咲く：08150_saku⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Cherry blossoms have started blooming in various places across the country.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{各地|かくち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are traditional festivals in various parts of Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{各地|かくち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: Tourists visit from all over the world.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧{各地|かくち} (various places across the country)
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{各地|かくち} (various parts of Japan)
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{各地|かくち} (various parts of the world)
- {各地|かくち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (in various places)
- {各地|かくち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (of various places)

REGISTER: Formal. Commonly used in news reports, announcements, and written Japanese.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{方々|ほうぼう}→方々：00116_houbou⟧ (here and there, everywhere - less formal)
- ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧ (here and there - casual)
- ⟦{各所|かくしょ}→各所：16088_kakusho⟧ (various locations - similar formality)
- ⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧ (various countries)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧ (producing area)
- ⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧ (local area, on-site)
